description.value: Nesvog Meats & Sausage is a family-owned butcher shop and deli that has served Nanaimo since 2005, earning a #1 Best in the City recognition for meat and deli. The Terminal Park location carries an extensive range of store-made sausages and deli meats, fresh and frozen local produce from the Nesvog Family Farm, ready-to-eat salads, baked goods, and general groceries. For a touring cyclist, it offers a well-stocked food resupply stop with many house-made and locally sourced options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and confirms the business is an active family-owned butcher/deli with two Nanaimo locations; the OSM phone (+1-250-753-4248) matches the Terminal Park location phone (250-753-4248), identifying this record as that specific location at 1533 Estevan Road. The website lists groceries, fresh produce, deli, and ready-to-eat items as confirmed offerings, but makes no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific infrastructure. The OSM name 'Nesvog's Meats & Sausages Co.' differs slightly from the website's 'Nesvog Meats & Sausage Co. Ltd.'—flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM name 'Nesvog's Meats & Sausages Co.' differs slightly from website branding 'Nesvog Meats & Sausage Co. Ltd.'—may warrant OSM tag correction.
OSM record has no address tag; address was sourced from the website's Terminal Park location page.
Business has two Nanaimo locations (Terminal Park and Bowen Road); confirm no duplicate OSM record exists for the Bowen Road location (2139 Bowen Road, 250-758-3611).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, well-established local butcher/deli with confirmed groceries, fresh produce, and ready-to-eat options—a practical food resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through Nanaimo. No bike-specific infrastructure confirmed, but the grocery offering alone qualifies it for the directory.
